verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch's own docs state it 'ships an MCP server of its own'. The server exposes collections, requests, environments, and teams so an agent can read and change them, and it can send real HTTP requests; a probe confirms the official MCP server docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server, documented setup/transport/auth details in the evidence.
